name: mirror_build
description: Mirror-completes a symmetric build (对称镜像): feed it a JSON block list of ONE half (plus any on-axis blocks) and the mirror plane; get the full list back. On-axis blocks are kept once; facing/shape states are remapped on the mirrored side.
when_to_use: ANY symmetric structure (对称建筑): palaces, halls, temples, symmetrical facades, animal figures. NEVER compute both sides by hand — generate one half, mirror it with this, then place the result. This is the standing fix for lopsided builds (偏殿).

input.notes: JSON file with the half build: {"blocks":[{x,y,z,block}...]} (a bare list also works)

axis.notes: mirror plane normal: x mirrors east-west, z mirrors north-south

axis_coord.notes: block coordinate of the mirror plane; may be a half-integer (e.g. 99.5) for a plane between two block rows
